name: paper-docs-rules-tests
description: Security rules regression tests for firestore.rules. The Firestore rules are the app's only enforced security boundary, and no Kotlin test exercises them: they run on the server, not in the app process. Firebase publishes rules-unit-testing for Node only, so this harness lives outside the Android build.

scripts.test:rules:emulated: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project paper-docs-rules-test "npm run test:rules"
